=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3327-3330 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `git rev-list ... | head -n 1` under `set -euo pipefail` can SIGPIPE and abort the refresh subshell, skipping later files.
  WHY: Multiple reviewers confirmed that when more than one commit is ahead, `head` closes the pipe early, `git rev-list` exits 141, and the per-file refresh loop stops before processing the remaining allowlisted files.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3328-3333 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: Suppressed `git rev-list` errors are indistinguishable from "no ahead commits," so the guard can refresh on git failure.
  WHY: Missing refs, shallow history, corrupt packs, or I/O/permission errors all produce empty output with no exit-status check, so the safety gate fails open instead of conservatively skipping the refresh.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3317-3330 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The gate compares against implicit `HEAD` instead of the explicit integration branch ref, so it can inspect the wrong tip outside the assumed worktree context.
  WHY: Reviewers noted that in detached-head or refactored invocation contexts, `HEAD` may not point at the intended integration branch, which can miss real ahead commits and let clobbering refreshes proceed.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3317-3378 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The refresh's own `[ai-maint]` commit can make future refreshes think the files are perpetually ahead of default_branch.
  WHY: Deepseek reported that after the first refresh the maintenance commit itself satisfies the ahead-of-default test, so later sync failures leave the resolver tooling stale because the helper will not run again.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:8060-8063 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The regex only matches a bare `done` line and rejects a harmless trailing comment after `done`.
  WHY: Multiple reviewers noted that an inline comment would trigger a false "could not find closing `done`" failure even though the shell loop structure is unchanged.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:8029-8094 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The regression test parses `_refresh_integration_resolver_tooling()` source text and exact command strings instead of exercising runtime behavior.
  WHY: Formatting-only refactors, quoting changes, or a safer `--max-count=1` rewrite would fail the test even though the safety property remains intact.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3307-3330 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `ahead_commit` is declared at function scope even though it is only used inside the per-file loop.
  WHY: Reviewers called this out as unnecessary scope and cognitive overhead, and it can confuse stale-state reasoning if the assignment is ever skipped.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3319-3335 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The loop spawns a fresh `git rev-list` process for every allowlisted file on every refresh attempt.
  WHY: That creates linear subprocess overhead that adds avoidable latency in the critical refresh path, especially as the allowlist or retry count grows.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3329 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `git rev-list ... | head -n 1` under `set -euo pipefail` can SIGPIPE and abort the refresh subshell, skipping later files.
  WHY: When a file has multiple ahead commits, `head` closes the pipe early, `git rev-list` exits 141, and the subshell dies before the rest of the allowlist is processed; this also makes the error handler return 0 after a silent partial refresh.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3329 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Suppressed `git rev-list` errors are indistinguishable from "no ahead commits," so the guard can refresh on git failure.
  WHY: With stderr redirected to `/dev/null` and no exit-status check, bad refs, shallow-history gaps, I/O errors, or permission denials all look like empty output, which lets the refresh proceed unsafely.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3317-3333 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The refresh's own `[ai-maint]` commit can make future refreshes think the files are perpetually ahead of default_branch.
  WHY: Deepseek reported that the first refresh creates a maintenance commit that itself satisfies the ahead-of-default gate, so later sync failures leave the resolver tooling stale because the helper no longer runs.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:8060-8061 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The regex only matches a bare `done` line and rejects a harmless trailing comment after `done`.
  WHY: A future editor adding an inline comment after `done` would get a misleading "could not find closing `done`" test failure even though the shell loop is semantically intact.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3327-3329 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `git rev-list ... | head -n 1` can SIGPIPE under `set -euo pipefail` and abort the refresh loop.
  WHY: When `head` exits after the first line, `git rev-list` receives SIGPIPE and exits 141, which trips `pipefail` and stops the function before remaining files are refreshed.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3328-3333 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `git rev-list` stderr is discarded and its exit status is not checked, so real git failures are treated as "no ahead commits."
  WHY: A corrupt repository, shallow clone, bad ref, or other git error can produce empty output that bypasses the safety gate and refreshes a file that should have been skipped.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3327 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The ahead-of-default check hard-codes `HEAD`, assuming the function always runs in a detached integration worktree.
  WHY: If the function is invoked in another context, `HEAD` may not point to the intended integration branch tip, and the guard can miss real ahead commits.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:8060-8061 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The `done_re` regex only matches a bare `done` line and rejects trailing comments.
  WHY: A harmless formatting change like `done  # loop end` would fail the test with a misleading missing-`done` error even though the shell structure is still correct.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:8029-8094 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The regression test inspects `_refresh_integration_resolver_tooling()` source text rather than exercising runtime behavior.
  WHY: Formatting-only refactors, quoting changes, or a safe `--max-count=1` rewrite can break the test even though the safety property is preserved.
